SELECT
  base.assessment_id,
  base.api_key,
  base.assessment_result,
  base.passed_standard,
  base.evaluated_at,
  base.created_at,
  base.updated_at,
  base.standard_name,
  base.standard_version_id,
  seed.is_bfs_v1_standard,
  seed.is_bfs_v2_standard,
  row_number() OVER (
    PARTITION BY
      base.api_key,
      base.standard_name,
      date(base.created_at)
    ORDER BY
      base.created_at DESC
  ) AS recency
FROM
  `my-gcp-project`.`testuser_base`.`base__app_store_dummy_model_149` AS base
INNER JOIN
  `my-gcp-project`.`dummy_schema_007`.`dummy_model_039` AS seed
  ON base.standard_name = seed.standard_name
  AND seed.is_bfs_v2_standard
LEFT JOIN
  `my-gcp-project`.`testuser_base`.`dummy_model_065` AS bsv
  ON base.standard_version_id = bsv.standard_version_id
  AND NOT bsv.longboat_is_deleted
  AND coalesce(bsv.is_not_deleted, FALSE)
WHERE
  NOT base.longboat_is_deleted
  AND (
    base.standard_version_id IS NULL
    OR date(base.created_at) BETWEEN coalesce(bsv.enforcement_start_on, date('2023-07-02'))
    AND coalesce(bsv.enforcement_end_on, current_date())
  )
QUALIFY
  recency = 1
